origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): the request that asks for a summary of a session that used tools, sent without the tools: a Gemini model behind a relay may refuse a history of calls and answers when no function is declared, so the history is written out as text. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
